Innovating Together for a Better Future
We strive to be an outstanding and highly strategic partner to the life sciences industry across its most critical areas, from clinical through commercial.
We are committed to the success of the people we work with, their companies, and the industry overall. We aim to provide products and services that deliver lasting value.
We deliver with focus and a clear vision to ensure our customers have innovative applications, agents, data, and high value services today and well into the future.

Aligned to our PBC purpose , we consider the interests of customers, employees, shareholders, and our communities, as we deliver solutions that help the industry in its mission to improve and extend life.

“By embedding AI into every step of the customer journey — from how practitioners receive valuable information about our portfolio to how they engage with our field force — Veeva is ideally positioned to support us in our mission to deliver life-changing medicines to patients worldwide.”
Accelerate study timelines by connecting clinical teams, sites, and patients on a complete platform.
Streamline regulatory processes, improve data quality, and respond faster to changing regulations.
Optimize and simplify quality processes for greater efficiency and streamlined collaboration.
Unify safety operations and safety science for greater efficiency and better decision-making.
Scale operations, engage experts, and accelerate insights with connected applications, agents, and data for medical affairs.
Enable more impactful customer interactions with the data and technology foundation for Agentic Commercial ™ .
Empowering Industry Leaders and Change Makers
“Collaboration between data management and clinical operations has always been important, but it was never truly supported by technology. Now, we have a platform that facilitates that collaboration.”
Michael Haushalter Senior Principal Capability Manager, Boehringer Ingelheim
“We’re able to capture data through the authoring and publishing process and use it in regulatory strategy and planning.”

“We’ll connect clinical data directly into our safety database, reducing multiple data entry and making our processes more efficient.”

“Pre-call planning with Veeva Link increases customer engagement by 50% because it helps our commercial teams better understand their customers.”
Andres Diaz Executive Director, Head of Experience Services and Digital Innovation, Genentech
“By revealing individual HCP barriers, drivers, and sentiment, Commercial Evidence allows the field to personalize their next engagement and progress them along the adoption journey.”

Celerion enhances Patient-Centricity and Improves Efficiency with Veeva eConsent
Make clinical trial participation more accessible and convenient
With MyVeeva for Patients, study participants can:
Easily find trial documents, additional resources, and contact information from the study homepage.
Keep up-to-date with where, when, and how their upcoming study visits will take place, including linking to virtual visits directly from the app.
Flag questions and request non-urgent support without having to call the site directly.
Review and complete informed consent, with easy-to-follow sections and interactive elements such as videos and questions. Learn more
Receive notifications when an ePRO is due and make survey completion easier with a modern experience on web or native app. Learn more
